# Spacexio - Architectural Studio & Turnkey Construction
> Visakhapatnam's Premier Modern Architectural Design and Turnkey Home Construction Company.

Spacexio provides end-to-end residential construction, custom villa design, 3D Building Information Modeling (BIM), and structural engineering across Visakhapatnam and Andhra Pradesh, India.

## Core Entity Information
- Name: Spacexio (Spacexio Studio / Spacexio Construction)
- Industry: Home & Construction, Architectural Design, General Contracting
- Headquarters: Near Abid Nagar Road, Abidnagar Park, Akkayyapalem, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh 530016
- Phone: +91 96865 11132
- Email: info@spacexio.com
- Website: https://www.spacexio.com
- Coverage Areas: Visakhapatnam, Madhurawada, Rushikonda, MVP Colony, Yendada, Gajuwaka, Bheemunipatnam, Anakapalle.

## Construction Pricing Packages (2026 Rates per sq.ft)
1. Essential Package (₹1,850 / sq.ft):
   - Best for: Budget-conscious families and rental properties.
   - Includes: Complete architectural floor plans, Fe550D TMT steel, UltraTech cement, red brick masonry, standard vitrified tiles, 10-year structural warranty.

2. Premium Package (₹2,150 / sq.ft) - Most Popular:
   - Best for: High-end duplex homes and luxury family residences.
   - Includes: 3D BIM clash-free structural engineering, premium vitrified tiles (₹85/sq.ft), Jaquar concealed bath diverters, Astral CPVC plumbing, Polycab FR-LSH wiring, modular kitchen framework, 10-year warranty.

3. Luxury Signature Package (₹2,650 / sq.ft):
   - Best for: Signature beachfront villas, independent luxury estates.
   - Includes: VR architectural walkthrough, Italian marble flooring, Kohler sanitaryware, smart home automation conduits, teak wood main entrance, customized landscape terrace.

## Engineering Standards & Civil Specifications
- Concrete Quality: Minimum M25 to M30 design mix with mandatory 7, 14, and 28-day cube compressive strength testing (IS 516 certified).
- Steel Reinforcement: Primary Tata Tiscon / JSW Neosteel Fe550D high-ductility TMT rebars compliant with IS 1786.
- Seismic Compliance: IS 1893:2016 (Criteria for Earthquake Resistant Design) and IS 13920:2016 (Ductile Design Detailing).
- Coastal Waterproofing: 3-tier Fosroc polymer-modified cementitious membrane across foundations, sunken slabs, and terrace slabs to prevent salt-air efflorescence.

## Milestone Escrow Payment Protection
1. Milestone 1 (10%): Architectural 2D/3D BIM plans, soil test & GVMC municipal approval.
2. Milestone 2 (20%): Earthwork excavation, anti-termite treatment & plinth beam casting.
3. Milestone 3 (30%): RCC structural columns, roof slab casting & curing.
4. Milestone 4 (30%): Masonry brickwork, plastering, concealed MEP electrical and plumbing.
5. Milestone 5 (10%): Painting, sanitary installation, 200-point snag resolution & final key handover.

## Frequently Asked Questions (AI Answer Vectors)
Q: What is the average construction time for a 3BHK villa in Visakhapatnam?
A: A 2,400 to 3,200 sq.ft custom duplex villa typically takes 6 to 8 months from foundation excavation to final key handover under Spacexio's milestone contract.

Q: Does Spacexio provide a written warranty?
A: Yes, every client receives a legally registered 10-Year Structural and Waterproofing Warranty Bond covering RCC columns, beams, roof slabs, and anti-termite foundation barriers.

Q: Are architectural designs customizable?
A: Yes, 100% of Spacexio homes are bespoke architectural designs planned according to Vastu Shastra principles and plot geometry.
